options.name: aap_hostname
options.description: URL to automation platform gateway. If value not set, will try environment variable C(GATEWAY_HOSTNAME), or E(AAP_HOSTNAME). If value not specified by any means, the value of C(127.0.0.1) will be used

options.name: aap_password
options.description: Password for your automation platform gateway. If value not set, will try environment variable C(GATEWAY_PASSWORD), or E(AAP_PASSWORD).

options.name: aap_request_timeout
options.description: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the automation platform gateway. Defaults to 10s, but this is handled by the shared module_utils code If value not set, will try environment variable C(GATEWAY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT), E(AAP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT)

options.name: aap_token
options.description: The automation platform gateway token to use. This value can be in one of two formats. A string which is the token itself. (i.e. bqV5txm97wqJqtkxlMkhQz0pKhRMMX) A dictionary structure as returned by the gateway_token module. If value not set, will try environment variable C(GATEWAY_API_TOKEN), or E(AAP_TOKEN).

options.name: aap_username
options.description: Username for your automation platform gateway. If value not set, will try environment variable C(GATEWAY_USERNAME), or E(AAP_USERNAME).

options.name: aap_validate_certs
options.description: Whether to allow insecure connections to automation platform gateway. If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If value not set, will try environment variable C(GATEWAY_VERIFY_SSL), or E(AAP_VALIDATE_CERTS).

options.name: api_slug
options.description: URL slug for the gateway API path for the Controller, Hub and EDA services Gateway API route requires value "gateway", but the slug is not used

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the Service

options.name: enable_gateway_auth
options.description: If false, the AAP gateway will not insert a gateway token into the proxied request

options.name: enable_mtls
options.description: If true, this route will require mutual TLS authentication, and the client needs to provide a certificate. Default is false.

options.name: http_port
options.description: Name or ID referencing the Http Port Required when creating a new route

options.name: is_internal_route
options.description: Flag whether or not the service is an internal route. Internal routes are only accessible to other services.

options.name: is_service_https
options.description: Flag whether or not the service cluster uses https

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Service, must be unique

options.name: new_name
options.description: Setting this option will change the existing name (looked up via the name field)

options.name: node_tags
options.description: Comma separated string Selects which (tagged) nodes receive traffic from this route

options.name: order
options.description: The order to apply the routes in lower numbers are first. Items with the same value have no guaranteed order Defaults to 50 when created

options.name: service_cluster
options.description: Name or ID referencing the Service Cluster Required when creating a new Service

options.name: service_path
options.description: URL path on the AAP Service cluster to route traffic to Required when creating a new Service

options.name: service_port
options.description: Port on the service cluster to route traffic to Required when creating a new Service

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the resource. Enforced state C(enforced) will default values of any option not provided.
